basic_details.job_title: Calicut University Electricity Worker Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Engineering Department of the University of Calicut is filling one Electricity Worker post on contract basis, open only to OBC candidates (Other Backward Classes, except those who have a specific turn in the Rotation chart) under the NCA category, at a monthly consolidated remuneration of ₹20,280. Candidates must be not more than 40 years old as on 01.01.2026 and must apply online by the 15th day from the notification dated 6 November 2026, which is about 21 November 2026 (15 days from 6 November 2026).

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: 15th day from the date of this Notification (about 21 November 2026)

how_to_apply: Applications are to be submitted online. The last date for receipt of online applications is the 15th day from the date of the notification, 6 November 2026. After the online applications are received, the Recruitment Section is to take action to conduct an interview. The notice does not give the application portal address or a list of documents to attach.

content_sections.heading: About Calicut University
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Registrar of the University of Calicut (Ad.-A), Calicut University P.O. It is titled "First NCA Notification" and is dated 06.11.2026. The post is in the University's Engineering Department.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only candidates belonging to the OBC Community can apply. This excludes those who have a specific turn in the Rotation chart. The post is filled under the NCA category. Desirable: 1. VIII Std. 2. Wireman's Licence. Experience: at least one year experience as NMR or two years continuous experience as CLR in KSEB / Electricity Wing of PWD or in any of the similar quasi Govt. concerns, or 4 years experience in construction and maintenance of overhead line for distribution of power under any reputed firm. Age: not more than 40 years as on 01.01.2026. Relaxation in upper age limit is given as per rules; the notice does not print the amounts. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

rows.requirement: Must be able to read and write English and Malayalam

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post carries a monthly consolidated remuneration of ₹20,280/- (Rupees Twenty thousand two hundred and eighty only). The appointment is on contract basis.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Calicut University Electricity Worker
content_sections.text: Applications are to be submitted online. The last date for receipt of online applications is the 15th day from the date of the notification, 6 November 2026. After the online applications are received, the Recruitment Section is to take action to conduct an interview. The notice does not give the application portal address or a list of documents to attach.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice directs the Recruitment Section to conduct an interview after online applications are received. It does not describe the interview marks, the venue or the date.

faq.question: Q1. How many Electricity Worker vacancies are there at Calicut University?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy, reserved for OBC (OBC - 1) under the NCA category.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Calicut University Electricity Worker post?
faq.answer: The last date is the 15th day from the date of the notification, 6 November 2026, which is about 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for this Electricity Worker post?
faq.answer: Only candidates of the OBC Community can apply, except those who have a specific turn in the Rotation chart. The post is under the NCA category.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Electricity Worker post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be able to read and write English and Malayalam. VIII Std. and a Wireman's Licence are desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What experience is required?
faq.answer: At least one year as NMR or two years continuous as CLR in KSEB / Electricity Wing of PWD or similar quasi Govt. concerns, or 4 years in construction and maintenance of overhead line for distribution of power under any reputed firm.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Not more than 40 years as on 01.01.2026, with relaxation in the upper age limit as per rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of the Electricity Worker?
Q8. Is the Electricity Worker post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is on contract basis, as stated in the notice.

faq.question: Q9. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted online by the 15th day from the notification date. An interview is to be conducted after the online applications are received.
